name: drosha ribonuclease III

function.text: DROSHA encodes ribonuclease 3. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and ribonuclease III activity. It participates in pre-miRNA processing and rRNA processing.

function.text: DROSHA encodes the catalytic ribonuclease III component of the microprocessor complex. In the nucleus, it cleaves primary microRNA transcripts to release stem-loop precursor microRNAs. These precursors are subsequently exported to the cytoplasm for further processing. DROSHA therefore acts early in the microRNA-production pathway, working with an RNA-binding partner rather than carrying out all of the steps needed to produce mature microRNAs.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DROSHA have been reported in Wilms tumor, pineoblastoma, and wilms' tumor.
